artifact: PHASE 4B §19-§21 - the one resolution path, its states and why order cannot decide
pipeline: reject an unsafe snapshot set outright
filter by company, scope, kind, key, period and as-of
check the declared type and currency
drop snapshots explicitly superseded within the surviving scope
apply the optional LATEST_ON_OR_BEFORE as-of mode
0 candidates is MISSING, more than 1 is AMBIGUOUS, exactly 1 is RESOLVED

resolved.reason: exactly one candidate matches; selected by EXACT_IDENTITY

missing.reason: no input matches METRIC "absent" for company gate-company / instrument gate-instrument at the requested period and as-of identity

ambiguous.reason: 2 candidates match this identity exactly (s1@1, s2@1); no supersession relation distinguishes them

incompatible.reason: the input identity exists but every candidate has value type RATIO where the IR declares MONEY

notApproved.reason: the fact exists but only in snapshots with status DRAFT; this evaluation accepts APPROVED

crossCompany.reason: no input matches METRIC "m" for company gate-other-company / instrument gate-instrument at the requested period and as-of identity

companyLevelReuse.reason: exactly one candidate matches; selected by EXACT_IDENTITY_VIA_COMPANY_LEVEL_APPLICABILITY
